column1: # Post-drain 16MB layout. NOT ACTIVE YET -- platformio.ini still points at
# partitions.csv. Switch board_build.partitions to this file only after the
# device has been drained and /config/vault has been backed up
# spiffs DESTROYS the existing LittleFS filesystem.
# What changes vs partitions.csv:
#   - app1 (0x3F0000) is gone. The project has no OTA path
#     slot was 3.94MB of flash that could never be written.
#   - coredump moves from 0x800000 up to 0x410000
#     freed space is contiguous with the tail of flash.
#   - spiffs starts at 0x420000 and runs to the end of the 16MB part:
# What survives: nvs (all SettingsManager Preferences).
# What is lost: everything on LittleFS -- the spool
# locations.json
# Boot note: otadata is kept and app0 stays subtype ota_0
# behaves exactly as it does today. With ota_1 absent
# full chip erase so a stale otadata entry cannot select a partition that is
# no longer there.
# Name
nvs
otadata
app0
coredump
spiffs
